description: What is driving US consumer prices, from the BLS's CPI: all items and core beside food (at home and away), energy and gasoline, core goods and used cars, core services, shelter, rent, owners' equivalent rent, medical care and transportation services, each on the month (seasonally adjusted), over three months at an annual rate and on a year as the BLS states it, with the headline and core month by month. A plain summary first. No key.

months.description: Months of the headline and core shown, latest last; default 13.

name: inflation_breakdown

outputSchema.description: rows are CPI components in the order of columns (percent changes on the month, over three months annualized and on a year); headline_and_core is all items and core month by month.

title: CPI by component (BLS)
